models.name: MARP-Det-v3
models.notes: General benthic detector. The workhorse for CAMPA and PACIFIC transect video.

versions.preferred_note: Preferred for detect-and-track on CAMPA and PACIFIC transect video. Holds tracks through the silt clouds the earlier weights lost them in. Not preferred for still quadrats, where MARP-Urchin-Count still counts better.

models.name: MARP-Inverts-YOLO
models.notes: Invertebrate-only detector, kept for comparison against MARP-Det-v3.

models.name: MARP-Rockfish-Cls
models.notes: Rockfish species classifier, run over crops from a detection pass.

versions.preferred_note: Preferred for rockfish classification from detection crops. Separates quillback from rosethorn, which every earlier version confused. Wants crops at 224 px or better.

models.name: MARP-Fish-Det
models.notes: Fish detector and tracker for mid-water and near-bottom passes.

models.name: MARP-Substrate-Seg
models.notes: Substrate segmentation for habitat classification. Its classes are not species.

models.name: MARP-Sponge-Det
models.notes: Glass sponge reef work. Trained mostly on VENTS and SALT imagery.

models.name: MARP-SeaStar-Det
models.notes: Asteroid detector built for the wasting-disease time series.

models.name: MARP-Crab-Det
models.notes: Commercial crab counts. Low class count, high precision requirement.

models.name: MARP-Urchin-Count
models.notes: Density counting over fixed quadrats. Reduction is count-per-frame, not tracks.

models.name: MARP-Multiclass-Det-XL
models.notes: Everything in one detector. Slow, and the only model here that needs 24 GB to run.
